items.title: CVE-2026-137308 - markdownify-mcp before 1.2.0 SSRF Protection Bypass via validateUrl and validateRepoUrl
items.one_liner: Check MCP tooling for markdownify-mcp versions under 1.2.0, as prompt injection can trigger SSRF against cloud metadata and internal endpoints.
items.summary: An SSRF protection bypass vulnerability (CVE-2026-137308) affecting markdownify-mcp versions prior to 1.2.0 allows attackers to bypass URL validation controls by supplying DNS names, bracketed IPv6 literals, or IPv4-mapped IPv6 addresses. Through prompt injection, malicious actors can influence URLs passed to webpage-to-markdown or git-repo-to-markdown functions to retrieve internal hosts, loopback services, and cloud metadata endpoints. The flaw stems from insufficient validation in the validateUrl and validateRepoUrl functions.
key_facts: CVE-2026-137308: SSRF Protection Bypass in markdownify-mcp
items.bottom_line: Update markdownify-mcp immediately to version 1.2.0 or later to patch the SSRF validation bypass.
